name: opengui
description: Control one to four local Android phones through bounded screenshots and allowlisted actions from Codex or DeepSeek Harness.

interface.shortDescription: Control local Android phones safely from Codex
interface.longDescription: OpenGUI gives Codex a local, USB-first Android control loop with bounded screenshots, frozen device sessions, observation freshness, allowlisted actions, cancellation, and a read-only device wall. Browser-only work stays in the native Codex Browser.
defaultPrompt: Use OpenGUI to inspect and operate my connected Android phone.
Open the OpenGUI device wall for my connected phones.
Check why my Android phone is not authorized for OpenGUI.
